company.name: Karma Snap
company.shortDescription: Karma Snap is an online platform that connects NPOs, foundations, and corporations together to facilitate the creation of campaigns.
company.description: KarmaSnap is a platform that connects non-profits, foundations and corporations to individual altruistic users, who wish to make a difference. KarmaSnap helps users to create campaigns, fundraise and donate all from a mobile app. KarmaSnap makes doing good easy, as easy as sharing.
